name: glyph-background

frames.best_why: A large ring of glowing glyphs and the full centred headline are both clearly visible.

tagline: A field of tiny characters glows and ripples under the cursor.
summary: A WebGL background of monospace letters that gather into drifting clouds of light. Moving the pointer leaves a glowing trail, and clicking sends a rounded ring of characters outward.
appearance: A near-black surface packed with tiny white monospace characters, brighter in soft cloud shapes and in large rings. A centred white headline and a dim paragraph sit over the field.
behaviour: Glowing clouds drift slowly and characters cycle randomly. Pointer movement brightens a trail of nearby glyphs, while a click spawns an expanding ring pulse that fades out.
demo_content: Heading 'Every character, alive' and hint 'Move to leave a trail of light. Click to send a pulse through the field.'
use_when: A dark hero or section wants an ambient field of text that responds to pointer and click.
avoid_when: The copy must be perfectly legible; busy glyph clouds sit directly behind the headline.
customise: Set glowColor, shapeColor, fontSize and interactive, and pass children for overlaid copy. The glyph set, drift, wave shapes and timings are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader redrawn every frame over a glyph atlas.

a11y.note: The decorative canvas is aria-hidden; reduced motion stops the loop and the pointer effects.

issues: The glyph clouds sit behind the headline and reduce its contrast.
The effect needs WebGL and shows no visible fallback when it is unavailable.
polish_why: Layered glyph clouds and satisfying ring pulses; busy texture fights the centred copy.
